title: スーパーリアル麻雀 Venus Returns
description:
The legendary strip mahjong series returns as Stripjong - Super Real Mahjong Venus Returns—its full-scale comeback in cutting-edge 3D and VR!

Win at mahjong, and the heroine sheds a piece of clothing.

A simple yet sublime experience, reborn with a sense of presence like never before!

◇ Industry-First 3D Strip Animation! Overwhelming Immersion!Dynamic camera angles and meticulously crafted animation that only 3D can deliver!

She's right there in front of you... The ultimate strip scenes, played out close enough to hear her breathe!

◇ Game OverviewThe crowning jewel of arcade strip mahjong makes its grand return after 30 years!

Showko, manager of the mahjong café P's Club, lays down the rules:

"Strip mahjong is simple—whoever loses takes something off."

Mizuki, Aya, Akira, and Showko—

Heated one-on-one matches with four unforgettable heroines begin now. What awaits you beyond victory...?

◇ What Is Strip Mahjong?A one-on-one battle of nerves, where every victory costs the heroine another piece of clothing. That's strip mahjong.

From the 1980s through the early 2000s, strip mahjong was a major genre of Japanese arcade gaming. It was a more carefree era: cabinets stood not only in arcades, but in shopping centers, hotels, even aboard ferries. And at the heart of the craze was the Super Real Mahjong series, born in 1987.

In an age when still images were the norm, its heroines moved in fluid animation—and blushed. That shock is still remembered today as a bittersweet page in the youth of countless players.

Players kept feeding in 100-yen coins, desperate to see what came next.

Nearly all of them went home defeated.

Super Real Mahjong was, after all, an arcade game—built to separate challengers from their coins as efficiently as possible. So the moment a heroine's last garments were at stake, she would suddenly start playing like a demon.

Ten seconds. That's how fast some players lost their coin after pressing start. Ten seconds.

Was it fair? No. Did they line up to play anyway? Absolutely.

In time, tightening regulations and shifting circumstances drove strip mahjong out of the arcades. But in its day, it was more commonplace than one can imagine now, with numerous developers sustaining the genre. It was no mere pastime—it was a cultural phenomenon that genuinely moved Japanese entertainment and its economy.

Looking back from an era of instant access to explicit content, strip mahjong may seem like an oddity. But the young players of that time invested their hard-earned coins and hours, learned the rules of mahjong, and fought through difficulty that can only be described as unfair—all for their "reward." It was never just about the destination. It was the struggle they were hooked on.

Strange, a little absurd, yet burning with a passion all its own—this uniquely Japanese gaming culture deserves to be passed on to the next generation.

This game is its true successor, born from that very wish.

And now, at long last, she takes off even "the last piece"—the one the regulations of that era never allowed you to see.

◇ Features• Mahjong matches, dramatically evolved in full 3D!
Just you and her—and she stays undressed as the match goes on!

Through the game of mahjong, you might just see a side of the heroines no one else gets to see.

You can even touch them mid-match and enjoy their reactions...?

• Auto Mode Included—But the Heroines Show No Mercy
"I don't know the rules of mahjong..." No problem.

Auto Mode plays your turns for you at the press of a button, so you can breeze through the story and strip scenes. (Toggle it on or off anytime, even mid-match.)

• Toggle It Freely! The "Compliance" Feature—Hide Sensitive Areas with the Mysterious Light
Sensitive areas during matches and strip scenes can be covered with the time-honored "mysterious light."

Handy for streaming, or for playing somewhere a little too public!

Beyond a simple ON/OFF toggle, you can even adjust its size to match the compliance standards of each era.

• Deeper Immersion with VR Mode (Sold Separately as DLC)

The base game (Desktop Mode) includes all game content. VR is not required.

That said—add the VR Mode DLC, and the game becomes playable with a VR headset.

The heroine, seated right across the mahjong table.

Stand up. Walk around her. Lean in close.

The feeling that someone is truly there, playing mahjong with you—only VR can deliver it.

"Zero-distance undressing" becomes exactly that: zero distance.

The VR Mode Bundle, which includes the base game and the DLC together, is also available. Already own the base game? The DLC alone is all you need.

◇ Please Read Before Purchasing• The sexual content in this game consists solely of clothing-removal (striptease) scenes. There are no depictions of explicit sexual acts.

• In compliance with Japanese law, genitals are not depicted (not modeled).

• This is a two-player strip mahjong game, faithful to the traditional format of the genre. There is no four-player mode.

• There is no tutorial for the rules of mahjong. Auto Mode can play for you, but it does not guarantee victory.

• Difficulty is challenging, true to the original arcade releases(difficulty settings and unlimited free continues available).

• The game currently supports resolutions up to Full HD (1920×1080).

• VR Mode is a separately sold DLC. All content can be played in the base game without VR.

Now, experience zero-distance undressing!
description_short: Stripjong is back—Super Real Mahjong, Japan's arcade legend! Lose, and the clothes come off! One-on-one strip mahjong. View strip scenes from any angle and distance with the industry-first Point-blank Strip Mahjong System. 100% without VR, 120% with VR Mode DLC. Experience zero-distance undressing!
